description: Fork of exp513 (E=64, 89.4M, 1.4825, untied Linear head + residual_lut + D-stream). THREE coupled changes: (1) residual_lut REMOVED (no D-stream). (2) Linear unembedder REMOVED. (3) V2D-tied head: logits = ln_x_v2d(VectorToDominance(x_lut)) @ ln_emb_v2d(VectorToDominance(tok_emb_E.weight)).T. VectorToDominance is the pairwise sign-of-difference projection from E-dim to P = E*(E-1)/2 dims; at E=64 that's P=2016. Hard ±1 forward, soft rational backward (STE). Default full triu pairs (deterministic), so both V2D calls share pair set. SEPARATE LayerNorms on each side, ln_emb_v2d.gamma init = 0.1 to avoid the exp572/573 'random-peak at init' warmup pathology (logit scale ~1 at init instead of ~sqrt(2016)~45). 'Tying token embeddings in dominance space' — the dot product in V2D space measures pairwise-order agreement, finer than raw direction. Predicted params ~58M (-31.5M vs exp513: -residual_lut -Linear_head). Predicted bandwidth at fp32: ~62 Mbits LUT backbone + ~2.11 Gbits V2D-tied head = ~2.17 Gbits/token (5× exp513's 465 Mbits!). With 1-bit storage of ±1 V2D outputs the head bandwidth could drop to ~66 Mbits — deployment story. This run is a PROOF-OF-CONCEPT for the V2D-tied mechanism, NOT a bandwidth winner at fp32. Prior precedent: kendall_readout test (memory: project_unembedder_head_explorations) hit ~1.78 at E=64 with similar pairwise-sign tying but NO LN — the LN is the new lever. Refs: exp513 1.4825 (parent backbone), exp574 ~1.55-1.60 (no_resid + raw tied dot, E=96), exp567 1.4768 (untied Linear), exp328 tied vanilla 1.3882.
